intl_finance.notes: Vassar's Student Financial Services page lists the Certification of Finances among the required documents for international students applying for aid. The form itself says every international student (aid or not) must submit it before Vassar can issue an I-20 or DS-2019, and asks for the annual support for all four years in US dollars with documentation attached (source 3). International students who want aid at any time must apply for it when they apply for admission (source 2). Vassar does not accept the ISFAA in place of the CSS Profile and gives no CSS Profile fee waiver codes to international students (source 1). No separate submission date for students who do not apply for aid is published. The deadline pages show no year; the cycle years were applied.

notes: No official 2026-27 statement of Vassar-specific supplemental essay prompts was found, so supplements is unknown rather than none. Vassar's first-year requirements page (source 4) lists the Common App or Coalition Application, fee, school report, teacher evaluation and mid-year report, and describes only one optional extra, 'Your Space' (an open-ended optional upload with no prompt text). It does not state that there are no supplemental questions, and it does not mention the personal essay either, so its silence is not proof. The page footer shows a 2022 copyright and may not have been updated for this cycle. QuestBridge finalists complete a separate Vassar QuestBridge Writing Supplement (source 5), prompts not public.
